# virtfusion_server (Resource)

Represents a VirtFusion server. Create/Update/Delete are not implemented against this fork's real API shape (unverified); this resource is intended to be brought under management exclusively via `terraform import`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# virtfusion_server only supports bringing an existing server under
# management via `terraform import` — Create/Update/Delete are not
# implemented against this fork's real API shape. All
# attributes besides name/hostname are read-only (Computed).
resource "virtfusion_server" "node1" {}

import {
  to = virtfusion_server.node1
  id = "385e8f86-6cc8-4f88-8d1e-a8fece0f6b32"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `backup_creating` (Boolean)
- `boot_order` (List of String)
- `cpu` (String) Raw CPU string as returned by the API (e.g. "2 Core").
- `cpu_cores` (Number) Best-effort parsed CPU core count. Null if `cpu` could not be parsed.
- `created` (String)
- `current_monthly_period` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current_monthly_period))
- `deleting` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Server UUID.
- `iso_mounted` (Boolean)
- `memory` (String) Raw memory string as returned by the API (e.g. "10240 MB").
- `memory_mb` (Number) Best-effort parsed memory in MB. Null if `memory` could not be parsed.
- `migrating` (Boolean)
- `network` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network))
- `protected` (Boolean)
- `rescue` (Boolean)
- `state` (String) Unconfirmed semantics; observed as null in testing. Passed through as-is.
- `storage` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage))
- `suspended` (Boolean)
- `uefi` (Boolean)
- `vnc_enabled` (Boolean)
